career_ladder.note: Officers recruited through the JKPSC Combined Competitive Examination into the Junior Scale of Jammu & Kashmir Administrative Service (JKAS), J&K Police (Gazetted) Service (JKPS), and J&K Accounts (Gazetted) Service are governed by the J&K Combined Competitive Examination Rules, 2018 (SRO-103) and state service regulations, advancing through Time Scale, Selection Grade, and Special Scale up to induction into the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) under the state promotion quota.

exam_scheme.note: The JKPSC Combined Competitive Examination comprises three successive stages: Preliminary Examination (2 objective papers of 200 marks each; Paper II is qualifying with 33%), Main Examination (1 qualifying English paper of 300 marks and 7 descriptive merit papers of 250 marks each, 1,750 marks total), and Personality Test / Interview (250 marks), leading to a final merit ranking computed out of 2,000 marks.

stages.source_label: JKPSC Combined Competitive Examination Rules (SRO-103 of 2018)

papers.paper_name: Paper I: General Studies-I (National & International Current Affairs, History, Geography, Polity, Governance, Economy, Ecology & Science)
papers.negative_marking: 0.66 mark penalty (1/3rd deduction for each incorrect response)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Score in GS-I determines qualification for Mains shortlist in ratio of approx. 1:15 to 1:20 of total vacancies

papers.paper_name: Paper II: General Studies-II (CSAT — Comprehension, Interpersonal Skills, Logical Reasoning, Decision Making, Mental Ability & Basic Numeracy)
papers.negative_marking: 0.66 mark penalty (1/3rd deduction for each incorrect response)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 33% minimum qualifying marks (66 out of 200); qualifying only

stages.source_label: JKPSC Combined Competitive Examination Scheme & Syllabus

papers.paper_name: Qualifying Paper: General English (Comprehension, Precis, Usage & Vocabulary, Short Essay)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 25% minimum qualifying marks (75 out of 300); marks not counted for ranking

papers.paper_name: Paper I: Essay (Write essays on multiple themes in medium of candidate's choice)
Paper II: General Studies-I (Indian Heritage and Culture, History and Geography of the World and Society)
Paper III: General Studies-II (Governance, Constitution, Polity, Social Justice and International Relations)
Paper IV: General Studies-III (Technology, Economic Development, Bio-diversity, Environment, Security and Disaster Management)
Paper V: General Studies-IV (Ethics, Integrity and Aptitude)
Paper VI: Optional Subject — Paper 1 (Candidate's chosen discipline from official list of 27 optional subjects)
Paper VII: Optional Subject — Paper 2 (Candidate's chosen discipline from official list of 27 optional subjects)

stages.source_label: JKPSC Combined Competitive Examination Viva-Voce Guidelines

papers.qualifying_threshold: Shortlisting for interview conducted in approx. 1:2 to 1:3 ratio based on aggregate marks in Mains written papers; final merit computed out of 2,000 marks (1,750 Mains + 250 Interview)

financial_package.note: Officers appointed to the Junior Scale of J&K Administrative Service, J&K Police (Gazetted) Service, and J&K Accounts (Gazetted) Service are placed in Pay Level 8 (PB-2 ₹9,300 - ₹34,800 + Grade Pay ₹4,800; revised entry basic ₹47,600) under the Jammu and Kashmir Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2018 (SRO-193 of 2018) along with applicable Dearness Allowance and UT allowances.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Jammu & Kashmir Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2018 (SRO-193) & JKPSC CCE Official Notifications
financial_package.estimate_note: Gross salary calculated on Pay Level 8 entry basic pay of ₹47,600 + 58% Dearness Allowance (₹27,608) + House Rent Allowance (9% to 18% depending on posting location in J&K, e.g. Srinagar/Jammu urban vs district headquarters) + Medical Allowance (₹1,000/month) + Transport Allowance with DA. In-hand estimate reflects deductions including 10% NPS (Basic + DA = ₹7,521), State Life Insurance (SLI), and income tax.
official_perks: Government residential quarter / accommodation or HRA entitlement per posting zone
Official vehicle / transport facility or monthly transport allowance for field postings
Fixed monthly medical allowance of ₹1,000 and medical reimbursement under J&K health schemes
Electricity and water concessions for official quarters per UT service rules
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and annual earned leave encashment entitlement
District executive protocol and official communication allowances (mobile and broadband reimbursement)
